summary.text: Rob Chase is a Republican member of the Washington House of Representatives, representing District 4-Position 2 since January 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Rob Tupper.

paragraphs.text: Rob Chase served in the U.S. Army Reserve from 1972 to 1978 and earned a B.A. in business administration from Eastern Washington University.
